name: Mfaz’ Omnyama
description:
'''Mphatheni Khumalo''' popularly known as '''Mfaz’ Omnyama''' (1959–2001) was a [[South Africa|South African]] performer of [[Maskanda|Maskandi music]], guitar player, and lyricist.

He is known for his hit singles such as ''Khula Tshitshi Lami'', ''Ngisebenzile Mama'' and ''Ngiyashisa Bhe''.
